messages:
Priya: Quick sync 0 Launch social plan: need final hero, alt text, two thread narratives (benchmark + playbook), and three CTA variants by Mon EOD. Also want a fast A/B headline test on X. Any owners?
Noah: Ill own asset QA + alt text. Will validate sizes and upload by 5pm PT. Link to drafts once done.
Tasha: I'll draft CTAs and short/long thread copies. Propose CTAs: 1) Register webinar 2) Try demo 3) Read benchmark. Will add UTMs for each.
Eli: Routing decision: send webinar signups to `sdr:webinar-warm`; demo clicks to `ae:demo` with auto-tag `campaign=launch_v2`. Also sending raw clicks to analytics event `social_click` for cohorting.
Priya: Nice. For A/B headline: A) "Cut inference costs by 3x" B) "Ship faster: 95ms p99" We will run A in AM slot, B in PM.
Maya: I'll cover live replies first 90 minutes. Reply playbook: 1) Thanks + link to register 2) Ask role & use-case 3) Offer a short demo if interest. Use template: "Thanks! If you're building prod inference, register: [link]?utm... Want a quick chat? Reply with your role."
OpsBot: Reminder: calendar slot reserved Wed 09:00 PT (job: cal_5521).
Noah: Asset upload: https://drive.redwood.ai/rlw/launch_v2/amplify_pack. Files: amp_hero.png, amp_clip_16_9.mp4, amp_gif.gif. Alt text added.
Tasha: Draft X thread (benchmark, short):
1/ "Benchmarks matter: how we scaled down token cost 3x with smart batching."
2/ "Result: p99 latency from 320ms 1 to 95ms after routing + kv-cache."
3/ "Webinar Wed 1 register: [link]?utm_campaign=launch_v2&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social"
Priya: For LinkedIn, expand to 6 bullets + 3 screenshots. Noah will add captions.
Eli: Paid boosts: start small. Pause if CTR < 0.45% after 60m. Also rotate headline A/B after first hour based on engagement.
Noah: QA done. Verified accessibility alt text and color contrast for hero.
Priya: Scheduling (PT):
`Wed 09:00` 1 X organic (benchmark, headline A)
`Wed 09:05` 1 X paid boost (AM)
`Wed 12:00` 1 LinkedIn long thread (playbook)
`Wed 17:00` 1 X paid boost (PM, headline B)
Maya: Engagement triage: prioritise demo asks & job titles. I'll drop a 1-hour summary in this thread.
Tasha: Final CTAs with UTMs in Drive: `?utm_campaign=launch_v2&utm_medium=social&utm_source=x_benchmark` etc.
Eli: Automation note: add rule to ping `#ae-inbox` for leads with score >= 50 and tag `source:social_launch_v2`.
Priya: All looks good. If boosts underperform we'll pause and reallocate to LinkedIn. Ping me with any urgent issues.
OpsBot: Job queued: cal_5521 scheduled Wed 09:00 PT.
Noah: Anything else? I can run one final link-check at 08:30 PT on Wed.
Priya: Perfect 1 closing thread unless blockers. Thanks team :rocket:
